description: Deterministic health, scheduler, authorization, lifecycle, and acceptance gates across every Localgraph source and account.

cases.criterion: One body-free report independently detects a failed LaunchAgent, stale success receipt, expired authorization, missing export, and unexpectedly empty completed packet.
Requested and preparing provider evidence joins delivered, imported, rendered, and current local evidence while subsequent packets remain historically incomplete without an account-specific baseline.
Recording an exact locally completed baseline immediately advances the unified account status instead of leaving a stale baseline-required receipt until a later network sync.
The unified status command includes Instagram, Facebook, and Apple Messages accounts while redacting correspondence bodies and raw failure text.
A Facebook Page packet cannot be imported or accepted as a baseline until that exact Page has a recorded supported export capability observation.
